--1 CHECK DUPLICATE
SELECT ACN_ID, COUNT(1) CNT FROM BUSC.ATM_ACCOUNT
WHERE ISLATEST = 1
GROUP BY ACN_ID
HAVING COUNT(1) > 1

--2 TAGGED DUPLICATE
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY ACN_ID ORDER BY [FileName] DESC, INSERT_DTTM DESC ) RN , --define PKs in partition by
* into BUSC.ATM_ACCOUNT_WITH_DUP_20240321
FROM BUSC.ATM_ACCOUNT; --Target table to remove duplicate

--3 CHECK COUNT MAIN 
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM BUSC.ATM_ACCOUNT;

--4 CHECK COUNT DUP TABLE
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM BUSC.ATM_ACCOUNT_WITH_DUP_20240321;

--5 CREATE BU TABLE
SELECT * INTO BUSC.ATM_ACCOUNT_BU_20240321
FROM BUSC.ATM_ACCOUNT;

--6 UPDATE ISLATEST = 0
UPDATE BUSC.ATM_ACCOUNT_WITH_DUP_20240321 SET ISLATEST = 0 WHERE RN > 1

--7 CLEAN DUP
TRUNCATE TABLE BUSC.ATM_ACCOUNT; -- Truncate target table to remove duplicate

--8 INSERT BACK UNIQUE RECORDS ONLY
INSERT INTO BUSC.ATM_ACCOUNT --Target table to remove duplicate
SELECT
ACN_ID
,ACN_ATP_ID
,ACN_ACCOUNT_NUMBER
,ACN_ACCOUNT_NUMBER_MASKED
,ACN_APD_ID
,ACN_STATUS
,ACN_STATUS_DATE
,ACN_DELINQUENCY
,ACN_DELINQUENCY_DATE
,ACN_CUR_ID
,ACN_AMT_CODE_1
,ACN_BALANCE_1
,ACN_AMT_CODE_2
,ACN_BALANCE_2
,ACN_AMT_CODE_3
,ACN_BALANCE_3
,ACN_LAST_BATCH_UPDATE_DATE
,ACN_CREDIT_LIMIT
,ACN_TEMP_CREDIT_LIMIT
,ACN_TEMP_CREDIT_LIMIT_DATE
,ACN_GUARANTEE_AMOUNT
,ACN_GUARANTEE_TYPE
,ACN_GUARANTEE_EXPIRY_DATE
,ACN_LAST_FEP_HOST_TRACE_NBR
,ACN_LAST_HOST_FEP_TRACE_NBR
,ACN_SPECIFIC_DATA
,ACN_PART_NO
,ACN_CUSTOM_DATA
,ACN_STATUS_2
,ACN_STATUS_2_DATE
,ACN_LAST_SOURCE
,ACN_LAST_TERMINAL_ID
,ACN_FEP_HOST_SUM
,ACN_HOST_FEP_SUM
,ACN_PAN
,ACN_LAST_BATCH_SESSION
,ACN_FUNCTIONS
,ACN_OVERRIDE_PERMISSION
,ACN_ISS_ID
,ACN_LIMIT_CONFIG
,ACN_LAST_UPDATE_TS
,ACN_ACCOUNT_NUMBER_EKY_ID
,ACN_PAN_EKY_ID
,FileName
,TABLE_NAME
,isActive
,isLatest
,BNK_CODE
,SOURCE_CODE
,FILE_NAME
,insert_dttm
 FROM BUSC.ATM_ACCOUNT_WITH_DUP_20240321; -- Name of backup table to store duplicate records


--9 CHECK IF STILL HAVE DUP
SELECT ACN_ID, COUNT(1) CNT FROM BUSC.ATM_ACCOUNT
WHERE ISLATEST = 1
GROUP BY ACN_ID
HAVING COUNT(1) > 1

--10 COUNT TARGET
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM BUSC.ATM_ACCOUNT

--11 COUNT DUPS
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM BUSC.ATM_ACCOUNT_WITH_DUP_20240321
